name: auth-failure
description: A bearer-protected agent refusing the token. In auto mode a 401 from /api/v3/nodes used to be retried against /api/v2/nodes for a guaranteed second 401; a 401 is an answer about the credentials, not a missing endpoint, so the run now fails fast after exactly one request with a credential-shaped message. request_count and the absent v2 request pin that.

log_contains: netdata: could not list nodes: status 401
the agent requires a bearer token; check api_token
